correctness.rationale: Definition 1.1 reduces every finite injective labeled substructure to a weak order on its unordered pairs; conversely every such weak order satisfies the echelon axioms. Universality realizes each finite structure and homogeneity extends every coordinate-preserving finite isomorphism, proving the orbit bijection. Equality partitions prove the noninjective Stirling transform. The bundled exact script checks the arithmetic and independently enumerates all weak orders on up to six labeled pairs.
